Embark on the ultimate Yosemite adventure with this 4-day, 3-night out-and-back guided backpacking tour. Beginning at the famous Happy Isles Trailhead, this route takes you up the breathtaking Mist Trail, establishes basecamp in Little Yosemite Valley, and culminates in a thrilling ascent of the iconic Half Dome. With all permits and logistics handled by our expert guides, you can focus on the awe-inspiring waterfalls, granite domes, and the climb of a lifetime.
THE WHOLE TRIP AT A GLANCE
Sunrise Summits & The John Muir Trail

Your journey begins in the heart of the park at the North Pines Backpacker’s Camp. Meet your guide and fellow trekkers for a thorough gear check, safety briefing, and the distribution of group equipment and trail meals. Spend your first evening relaxing and bonding with your group under the towering granite cliffs, getting plenty of rest for the climb ahead.

After breaking camp in the Valley, we head to the Happy Isles Trailhead to begin our ascent. Today’s hike takes us up the steep and spectacular Mist Trail, where you will experience the sheer power of Vernal and Nevada Falls up close. We will climb from the valley floor into the backcountry, arriving at Little Yosemite Valley to establish our basecamp for the next two nights.

Today is entirely dedicated to conquering the legendary Half Dome cables! Basing ourselves in Little Yosemite Valley gives us the flexibility to time our summit attempt for the best possible experience. An early morning start for a sunrise summit is ideal, providing stunning lighting and leaving time for a backup attempt if afternoon weather rolls in. Alternatively, an evening ascent for a sunset summit offers equally breathtaking views of the High Sierra and a quieter trail.
Sunrise Summits & The John Muir Trail

If weather or trail conditions prevented our climb yesterday, we will make a final early-morning push for the Half Dome summit at sunrise. Afterward, we will pack up our basecamp and begin our scenic descent. We will hike back down to the valley floor via the iconic John Muir Trail (JMT), enjoying panoramic views of Liberty Cap and Nevada Fall before concluding our unforgettable trek back at Curry Village.
Casual Shoes for Travel and Free Time
Water Bottles (Three 1-liter) or Hydration System, Plus One 1-liter Water Bottle
Personal Bathroom Kit: Toilet Paper, Ziplock Bags, Personal Wipes, Hand Cleaner
Bandana or Buff for Sun Protection

This trip follows a mix of well-maintained and more rugged sections of the trail. Be prepared for periods of steep hiking, moderate to significant exposure, and, at times, loose surfaces that require attention and careful footing.

Participants will carry their own backpack weighing 35 to 40 lbs at a high elevation for several miles over steep, exposed, and rocky terrain, with constant and dramatic elevation gain and/or loss exceeding 2,000' or more per day on most days of this trip. Keep the high elevation of this trip in mind when training for this adventure, as backpacking/hiking will feel harder and use more energy than at lower elevations, especially if coming from a lower elevation/sea level. Previous backpacking experience is highly recommended; this is not a beginner's backpacking trip.

To maximize your enjoyment of the trip, we strongly encourage you to be involved in a consistent training regimen starting at least 3-6 months before the trip, ideally including training hikes with a weighted pack. We also recommend staying hydrated before departure to help mitigate the effects of hiking at high altitudes. Your overall fitness level is crucial to your enjoyment of this trip.
Hiking uphill or downhill with a 35-45lb backpack for 6-8 hours
Maintaining balance and footing on rugged, steep, or loose terrain
Is this trip right for you?
Maintained trails with uneven footing, steps and sustained climbs. Up to six miles across a full day, usually in two or three separate walks.
Full days out, often above 6,000ft, and canyon country runs over 100°F from June to August. Shade is not guaranteed.
Not suitable for a wheelchair, a walker or anyone who cannot manage stairs without a rail. Comfortable if you walk regularly.
Your guide may change or drop a stop for weather, road closures or time. What is walked on the day is their call.
Anything specific — a knee, a hip, a height worry, a wheelchair — is worth one phone call to 800-970-5864. We would rather move you to a different trip than have you on the wrong one.
Experienced hiking guide with extensive wilderness expertise, medical certifications, and a deep passion for leading adventurers through stunning landscapes.
This trip can't be booked online yet. Tell us which departure you have in mind and someone from our office will get back to you to check it and take the booking. Nothing is charged here.
We typically reply within one business day.
